what: The lead's measurements of 2026-11-13, copied from the lead's notes (2026-11-13-d1-lead-notes.md, written 01:02 UTC) and the fix brief (2026-11-13-fix-d1-encoder-devnet-test-prep.md, section 'What changed since you built it'). The lead measured them in the browser pane and on the PC. Reads only: nothing was signed with a real key and nothing was sent.

block_time_s.how: 21 blocks in 22.3 s, read in the pane on the node's own origin

finalized_lag_blocks.what: blocks the finalized head is behind the best head
finalized_lag_blocks.how: the pane, the node's own origin

mortal_life_blocks.what: blocks a device step lives from the read of its birth block, about a minute
mortal_life_blocks.how: the era of 64 blocks less the finalized lag, at the block time above

relay_hop_s.what: seconds one hop of the lead takes: a pane call or a PC call with a short text

signed_file_bytes_t3.what: bytes of signed/T3.json as sign-device.mjs of fcfb8b5 writes it
signed_file_bytes_t3.how: a throwaway key in a temporary folder on the PC

signed_file_bytes_t5.what: bytes of signed/T5.json as sign-device.mjs of fcfb8b5 writes it
signed_file_bytes_t5.how: a throwaway key in a temporary folder on the PC

extrinsic_hex_chars.what: hex characters of the extrinsic of T3

pane_call_limit_s.what: seconds after which a script call of the pane ends

runner_deadline_s.what: the runner's own deadline for a watch

pc_reaches_node.what: whether the PC's shell reaches the node
pc_reaches_node.how: curl to https://rpc.devnet.flop.network gives 403 from the proxy after CONNECT; node's fetch and WebSocket fail too. Not worked around

pane_websocket.what: the real WebSocket from a tab on https://rpc.devnet.flop.network/
pane_websocket.how: lab.heads() answered in 2.3 s: tzkv-runtime 1014020, transaction version 2, genesis as steps.json has it

owner_next_nonce.what: the owner's next account nonce before T1
owner_next_nonce.how: lab.deviceReads(<the owner's address>, <System.Events key>) in the pane, 1.7 s

explorer.what: FLOP's explorer answers GET /api/transactions/<extrinsic hash> with one JSON object
explorer.how: the lead read the rerun's A6 and A5 there: both agree with the committed record

explorer_answer_shape.value: keys hash, blockHash, method, section, sender, params, success (true or false), events, timestamp. Each event {id, section, method, data}. Names polkadot-js style: section computeChannel, flopSessionKeys, balances, system; method ForceOpenRequested; data keys camel case (channelId, ackDeadline, agent, miner, escrow). Numbers are strings with commas ("3,553,433"). Accounts are SS58 text. A failed extrinsic has success false and a last event system.ExtrinsicFailed whose data.dispatchError is {"Module":{"index":"94","error":"0x14000000"}}: pallet index 94, error index 20 in the first byte. There is no block number field. An unknown hash answers 404 with {"error":"Transaction not found"}
explorer_answer_shape.what: the shape of the explorer's answer
explorer_answer_shape.how: read in the browser pane by the lead

channel_id_formula.value: blake2b-256("FLOP/COMPUTE_CHANNEL/ID" || 0x01 || genesis || agent || miner || u64 little endian nonce), agent the owner
channel_id_formula.what: how a channel id is made
channel_id_formula.how: read by the lead in FLOP's SDK 0.6.0 (channelIdV1) and checked with our own lines against the rerun's A6: owner, NAMED and nonce 7320261112000001 give 0x7cee53edb4537323733eef3ff1bcac31fd09135ce94a8b6c8e3bae57619949f2, the channel_id of ComputeChannel.ForceOpenRequested in research/2026-11-12-session-rerun-1014020/results.json. Shown for force_open only
